messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: latency_p99_eu_west > 1.2s (auto-threshold). Alert id PD-98123.
pagerduty: Pager PD-98123 created and routed to oncall. Escalation policy: eng-oncall -> eng-sre.
alex: acked in PD. I'm on it. Starting quick triage.
mira: thanks alex. can you confirm which models/routes are hot? dashboard shows p95 also creeping.
alex: hitting our inference frontdoor for chat-stream, model: llamav2-q4, route: /v1/generate-chat. p99 ~1.6s, p95 ~0.65s.
leo: saw a spike in small-batch tail. KV cache hit-rate dropped from 87% -> 60% around 12:03 UTC.
anya: customer-impact? any 5xxs or user-facing errors?
alex: few 504s observed (~0.2% of requests) mostly for customers on shared-hosted. Not widespread but noticeable for realtime apps.
mira: ideas: warm KV cache, reduce batch window for this route, or fallback to cheaper model variant. Which is fastest?
sre-shift: warm cache via /admin/kvcache/warmup endpoint? can run on a small prefix set.
alex: running kvcache warmup now for hot keys (snippet):
```
POST /admin/kvcache/warmup
{ "prefixes": ["/chat/conv/active"], "concurrency": 8 }
```
alpha: (reaction :thumbsup:)
leo: also throttling continuous-batching param for that route to 16ms from 50ms to lower tail. Patching canary in 2 mins.
mira: roll forward plan: 1) warm KV cache, 2) lower batch window, 3) if SLO still burning, failover traffic to dedicated-pool-usw until stable.
alex: warmed ~70% of targeted keys, hit-rate up to 80% and p99 dropped to ~1.2s. still above SLO of 1.0s.
leo: canary patch applied to 10% traffic, seeing p99 down to 0.95s for canary. rolling to 50%.
anya: should we notify affected customers? recommend internal note first, then customer-status if residual impact >0.5%.
sre-shift: current SLO burn window shows 2.3% of total tokens in last 15m. below incident threshold for customer comms, but keep monitoring.
pagerduty: PD-98123 status: acknowledged by alex (on-call). No escalation.
mira: keeping this thread as coordination. alex, please handoff if you need rotation change.
alex: will handoff to leo at 13:10 UTC if still open. capturing runbook steps: 1) kvcache warmup, 2) reduce batch window, 3) patch fallback routing, 4) if >1% 5xxs, escalate to SE.
leo: taking over at 13:12 UTC. continuing roll to 100% canary.
incident-bot: Note: automatic paging suppression enabled for duplicate alerts for 10m.
alex: closing PD incident after metrics stable for 10m and p99 <=1.0s for two consecutive windows.
leo: p99 holding ~0.92s at last check. marking for postmortem if drift recurs.
anya: nice mitigation. please record exact timestamps + change ids for postmortem.
leo: change ids: deploy-4723 (batch-window tweak), ops-kwarm-88. will add to incident log.
incident-bot: PD-98123 resolved by oncall at 13:25 UTC.
